label: §1 · Classification
passage: External sharing is allowed only for Partner-shareable documents. Restricted documents must not be shared externally.

label: §2 · NDA coverage
passage: An active NDA must cover the exact supplier and intended purpose on the evaluation date. Validity includes both start and end dates. An expired NDA fails this check; an absent record is unknown.

label: §3 · Owner approval
passage: An active approval by the document owner must identify the report, recipient and purpose. An explicit denial fails. A missing matching record leaves permission unestablished; it does not prove approval never happened.

label: §4 · Evidence and conflicts
passage: Use evidence effective on the evaluation date. Unresolved opposing records require review. Otherwise explicit failures take precedence over unknown facts, and all checks must pass for permission. Simulated facts are hypothetical and never grant access.

label: Partner-shareable
passage: Partner-shareable material is eligible for external sharing subject to NDA and owner approval.

label: Restricted
passage: Restricted material must not be shared externally.
